name: Kokusai Electric
summary: Kokusai Electric Corporation is a global enterprise dedicated to the development, fabrication, sale, servicing, and upkeep of machinery vital for semiconductor production. Its extensive product catalog encompasses sophisticated deposition and treatment systems, precision measuring devices, and ultrasonic generators. Beyond core equipment, the company also supplies supplementary parts and deals in both new and pre-owned apparatus for wafer processing. Established in 1949, Kokusai Electric Corporation is based in Chiyoda, Japan.
